name: Games
doc: Games: a personal tabletop for game prototypes. Each game is an endless table you pan and zoom (phone and desktop) with pieces from reusable table components; the first is a 52-card poker set: drag, draw, merge, flip, shuffle and gather card stacks. The table is saved in the game; the agent can deal through the bar.
